course_name_original: Projecto Integrador de 1º Ciclo em Engenharia Mecânica (PI123610)
course_name_en: 1st Cycle Integrating Project in Mechanical Engineering
syllabus_topics: Project in Mechanical Engineering: work carried out by a group of students focused on the conception of a product, system or process within the scope of Mechanical Engineering, based on real and complex problems/challenges proposed by a tutor-lecturer or an external company
Individual Project in a company: individual project focused on a specific challenge presented by a host company that requires a solution or analysis oriented towards short-term implementation

JUNO Project: multidisciplinary teamwork based on real and complex problems/challenges presented by companies or institutions that require contributions from students from different IST/ULisboa courses

assessment_methods.method: Individual grade based on oral and written communications

assessment_rules: The final grade for the PIC is individual, a combination of the group grade and the individual grade based on oral and written communications. This evaluation occurs at the end of P3 and P4. Both the group grade and the individual grade must be equal to or greater than 9.5/20 in P3 and P4 to pass the course unit. More details on evaluation, including criteria, will be provided in the first course seminar.
bibliography: C.L. Dym, P. Little and E.J. Orwin, Engineering Design: A project-based introduction, Wiley, 4th edition, 2014 (main)
SI Edition, J. Wickert, K. Lewis, An Introduction to Mechanical Engineering, enhanced 4th edition, 2019 (main)
